why.title: A smart glasses company built differently
why.intro: Most agencies build a demo app. We build the whole working system: the glasses app, the AI inside it and the connection to your records.

items.title: Device-neutral by design
items.text: We build for Meta, XREAL, Snap Spectacles, MentraOS, Android XR, Samsung XR and RayNeo. We test devices with your team on site, so you buy the glasses that fit the job, not the ones that demo best.

items.title: AI built into the glasses
items.text: Vision models that read labels and flag damage, voice assistants that answer from your manuals, and agents that write the report. The AI is part of the app, not an add-on.

items.title: Connected to your back office
items.text: Every photo, checklist and note lands in your job, asset, claim or quality system through its existing APIs, so the report is complete before the wearer leaves the site.

items.title: Built for real working conditions
items.text: Offline steps for weak signal, voice control for gloved hands, minimal overlays for safety, and battery plans for full shifts. Designed on the shop floor, not in a meeting room.

services.title: Smart glasses app development services
services.intro: Six services that take a hands-on workflow from paper or tablet to smart glasses, with AI and your systems connected.

items.title: Custom smart glasses app development
items.text: Native apps for display, camera and AR glasses, built around one workflow and the people who do it.

items.title: AI vision and voice assistants
items.text: Models that read serial numbers, gauges and labels, and assistants that answer questions from your own SOPs.

items.title: Remote expert and see-what-I-see support
items.text: Live calls where a senior engineer sees the wearer's view, talks them through the fix and marks up the scene.

items.title: Guided inspection and checklist apps
items.text: Step-by-step procedures in view, photo and voice capture per step, and a complete report at the end of the job.

items.title: Back-office and ERP integration
items.text: Results written to SAP, Dynamics, Salesforce, ServiceNow or your custom system, with an audit trail for every step.

items.title: Device selection, pilots and fleet management
items.text: On-site device trials, a measured pilot with one team, then charging, updates, assignment and wiping at scale.

devices.title: Built on the glasses your teams will actually wear
devices.intro: Smart glasses fall into four broad types. We match the type to the job, then test the shortlist on your site before you buy in volume.

items.title: Display glasses
items.text: A small display in one or both lenses for checklists, step numbers and alerts in view.

items.title: Camera and AI glasses
items.text: Camera, microphones and speakers in a normal frame, for capture, voice assistants and remote calls.

items.title: AR glasses and headsets
items.text: Graphics placed in the world around the wearer, for spatial guidance and training.

items.title: Open platforms
items.text: Operating systems and SDKs that run one app across several glasses, so your app outlives the hardware.

items.q: What does a smart glasses app development company do?
items.a: We design and build the software that runs on smart glasses: guided workflows, photo and voice capture, remote expert calls and AI that reads the scene, plus the connections that send results to your business systems.

items.q: Which smart glasses do you develop for?
items.a: Meta, XREAL, Snap Spectacles, MentraOS, Android XR, Samsung XR and RayNeo. We pick the device per task after testing it with your team, and keep the app portable where the platform allows.

items.q: Why work with an India-based smart glasses developer?
items.a: You get a team that covers glasses apps, AI and back-office integration in one place, working across Indian, Middle East, European and US time zones, with on-site visits for discovery and device trials in India.

items.q: Do smart glasses apps work without internet?
items.a: Yes. Key steps run offline and sync photos, notes and results when the device or the paired phone reconnects. We design for weak signal in workshops, hangars and plants from the start.

items.q: How do you handle privacy when glasses have cameras?
items.a: Recording is limited to the steps that need it, with a visible indicator, consent steps for customers or patients, and storage in your own cloud under your access rules.

items.q: How long does a smart glasses pilot take?
items.a: A focused pilot with one team and one workflow usually runs for weeks rather than months. We agree the timeline and the success measures in writing after the on-site discovery.

items.q: Can we try smart glasses before we decide?
items.a: Yes. Try live demos at our desk at Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026, or book a session and we will show a demo built around a workflow like yours.
